Meta.title: Ali Tunacan Onar - Full-Stack Engineer
Meta.description: Full-Stack Engineer building SaaS products. Six years across fintech, healthcare AI, fitness, and B2B platforms.

Hero.name: Ali Tunacan Onar
Hero.intro: For six years I've been designing and shipping web and mobile products from scratch. I've worked across fintech, healthcare AI, fitness, and B2B, both inside product teams and as a freelance engineer owning projects end to end.

About.title: A full-stack engineer who takes products from idea to launch.
About.p1: I design and build web and mobile products from scratch, both inside product teams and as a freelance engineer running projects end to end. My work spans B2B platforms, AI-powered products, two-sided marketplaces, and SEO-driven corporate sites that rank on Google.
About.p2: What I care about: understanding the problem fast and getting it solved without detours, choosing technology based on what it will cost you over the years rather than what's easiest today, and keeping you in the loop in plain language throughout.

Work.title: Products I've built end-to-end.
Work.subtitle: SaaS products built from scratch, marketplaces, and stalled projects I took over and shipped.

adilanaliz.tagline: RAG-powered AI platform for legal professionals.
highlights: Significantly improved the RAG pipeline behind the legal AI chat, including retrieval quality and response relevance.
Auth hardening, iyzico payment integration, dealer/reseller model, and referral system.
Ongoing AI chat UX and conversation improvements, deployed on Hetzner.

aktek.tagline: SEO-focused corporate site for an industrial chiller service company.
highlights: Technical and on-page SEO work targeting first-page rankings for chiller service keywords in the Marmara region.
Local SEO structure, service pages, and performance optimization built on Next.js.

rumimetric.tagline: Comprehensive livestock ration and feed planning platform.
highlights: Took an AI-generated HTML/CSS/JS prototype and rebuilt it from scratch as a full production app.
Ration calculation, animal and feed management, and reporting flows on a modern stack.
Auth, database, and storage on Supabase; deployed on Railway.

tekliftamam.tagline: Multi-search quoting tool that speeds up wholesalers' quote workflows.
highlights: Bulk multi-product search so wholesalers can build quotes in minutes instead of hours.
Product catalog, quote management, and user flows built on Next.js and Supabase.

tigaa.tagline: B2B procurement SaaS with WhatsApp + AI quote engine.
highlights: Multi-company setup where each business can act as both buyer and supplier, with catalog and quote management.
WhatsApp Business API + OpenAI bot that extracts products from PDFs and images, then generates quote documents.
Multi-channel comms (WhatsApp, SMS, email), supplier confirmation automation, analytics dashboards.

meritrisk.tagline: Modernizing a 10-year-old multi-tenant risk platform used by major Turkish banks.
highlights: Full rewrite from PHP/MySQL to Next.js, Express, and PostgreSQL.
Migration plan for live tenants without breaking existing risk models.
Re-architected the data layer around econometric models from the finance team.

kolaytadilat.tagline: Two-sided marketplace for homeowners and renovation pros.
highlights: Took over a stalled AI-generated codebase and shipped it to production.
Built Express backend from scratch; redesigned the database for scalability.
Credit-based applications, milestone payments via Param, SMS verification, email.

ireturnticket.tagline: Travel documentation SaaS for visa applicants and border crossings.
highlights: Public booking flow, admin panel, and automated PDF generation.
Licensed GDS integration for real onward/return ticket documents.
Payments + automated email delivery, deployed on Railway.

sonic8.tagline: AI watermark generator and audio enhancement SaaS for sound files.
highlights: Inaudible AI watermarking for audio files, with Dolby APIs powering the audio enhancement pipeline.
Serverless integration layer connecting to the AI models (Supabase Edge Functions + Modal).
Auth, billing, and dashboard for processing and downloading watermarked audio.

oneclickgenerator.tagline: AI-powered privacy policy and support page generator for mobile apps.
highlights: Generates production-ready legal pages from a few app details.
Stripe checkout, Prisma data layer, deployed on Railway.

denersen.tagline: Turkish AI SaaS that turns raw product photos into professional product imagery and video.
highlights: Personal project built to explore the fal.ai image and video model APIs.
End-to-end flow from upload to generated, downloadable product visuals.
Subscription billing and full Turkish UX, currently live in production.

loadmuscle.tagline: AI workout planner, built solo and shipped to production.
highlights: 15,000+ app users and 60,000+ monthly web visitors.
React Native + Expo on mobile; Next.js on web with shared types.
Personalized programs generated from user goals and equipment.

Services.title: How I can help.
Services.subtitle: Whether you're starting with a fresh idea or stuck with software that can't keep up, I take it from where it is to a product that ships.

saas.title: SaaS products from scratch
saas.description: I turn your idea into a working web application end to end: user accounts, subscriptions and payments, an admin panel, and a solid foundation that won't hold you back as you grow.

rescue.title: Finishing stalled projects
rescue.description: I take over projects left behind by a previous team or generated with AI tools and stuck halfway. I find and fix what's broken, fill in the gaps, and get it live without drama.

mobile.title: Web and mobile apps
mobile.description: I build your product as a website and as iOS and Android apps, together. One team, one foundation, and the same experience for your users on whatever device they open it on.

consulting.title: Technical consulting
consulting.description: Which technology to pick, whether your current system is ready to grow, or whether the agency you're quoting is on the right track. An independent technical opinion before expensive mistakes get made.

seo.title: SEO and visibility on Google
seo.description: I handle the full SEO work that gets your website in front of customers searching on Google, from the technical foundations to content structure. Site speed, local search and page architecture included; the goal is always a measurable climb in rankings.

Contact.title: Have a product idea or a stalled codebase?
Contact.subtitle: Open to both freelance and full-time collaborations on new projects. A short email is enough, and I'll get back to you quickly.
